name: TigerImage
description: Image generation for any agent. Drives the Tiger provider adapters to turn a prompt into pictures, remembers how each one was made so it can be refined, and promotes the keepers into the Media Library. Gives a text-only assistant the ability to illustrate a page it just wrote.
_notes: Free, BSD-licensed first-party module. Generated images live in storage/tigerimage — OUTSIDE the module directory, because a module update renames the module dir away and deletes the backup (Tiger_Module_Installer), which would destroy anything stored inside it. See TIGER-101 for making purge remove that tree.
